title: The URDF import loses the colors of the materials of Collada meshes
author: Claude-JG
description: GetURDFrobotData reads the meshes by pymeshlab, which merges the parts of a Collada (.dae) file and drops the diffuse colors of their materials; the UR5 of ur_description, whose meshes have dark grey, light grey and blue parts, was drawn in the one grey of its URDF material. Decided: a small Collada reader (ReadColladaMesh, xml of the standard library) gives the triangles with the colors of their materials, used for a .dae mesh without a texture.
releaseNotes: The URDF import keeps the colors of the materials of Collada (.dae) meshes without texture, read by the new function ReadColladaMesh.
